title: PandaDoc extension not appearing in gallery despite matching documented requirements

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue reports that the PandaDoc extension is not appearing in the external extensions gallery (geminicli.com) or extensions.json. Local validation and installation succeed, and there is no indication of a systemic code defect in the gemini-cli repository itself. Because gallery indexing and crawler logs are handled by external infrastructure, additional information or registry/crawler log details are needed to determine why the extension was skipped.
triage_metadata.comment: Hi! Thanks for commenting on this issue, we need more information to triage the bug. Please note that the public extension gallery (geminicli.com) indexing pipeline is managed separately from the gemini-cli CLI repository. Local installation and validation succeed according to your report. Could you provide any specific crawler/indexing logs or error details if available, or confirm if you need manual verification from the gallery infrastructure team?
